market_view: Regime turned DEFENSIVE: VWCE.DE (-1.6%) and SXR8.DE (-0.1%) are both now below SMA200, breadth 41.4% above SMA200 / 29% above SMA50, median 20d -5.2%, and EQQQ.DE -6.8% below trend as the AI/tech sell-off continues. US markets reopen today for a half session after Thanksgiving, so no US ideas. Rule: at most 1 new buy at <=10%; with ~59% cash I add one low-volatility non-tech leader (Air Liquide) and keep all five holdings - no position-specific news found that breaks a thesis. IPO radar: no sizeable US/EU IPO verified for the next weeks; ANT (Anthropic, listed 19 Nov) reaches 10 sessions on 3 Dec and has its own user-requested task on 4 Dec - the analyst is not neutral on Anthropic, which makes Claude.

proposals.thesis: Air Liquide is one of the few leaders in a weak tape: screen close 188.46, +8.2% 20d, +11.6% vs SMA200, 2.5% off its 52w high, RSI 62, lowest volatility in the shortlist (15.8%). Q3 showed +3% comparable growth and management is confident of +100bp margin in 2026; Kepler raised its target to EUR 223 (buy) on 19 Nov. Adds French industrial gases - non-tech, non-bank diversification; FY results not until around late February.
proposals.risks: Santander cut to neutral (target EUR 207.50) on 17 Nov; a broad risk-off leg could drag even defensives; a close back below SMA50 (~EUR 177) would break the trend.
